fix(export): SVG window frame takes the theme's ink (rich-export-9a1.f98) (#246)

* fix(export): SVG window frame takes the theme's ink (rich-export-9a1.f98)

The frame stroke was Rich's fixed rgba(255,255,255,0.35), the one colour in
the export that ignored the TerminalTheme; around SOLARIZED_LIGHT's #fdf6e3
canvas it has no visible edge. It is now the theme foreground at Rich's 35%
opacity, which under the default theme (#ffffff ink) draws exactly what Rich
draws.

* fix(export): SVG frame is one opaque colour, blended from the theme (rich-export-9a1.f98)

Review (high): a translucent stroke broke export-lines' rule that no exporter
draws a translucent colour, and its outer half took the host page's colour.
The frame is now the ink blended 35% into the canvas with blendRgb; over
black that is #595959, what Rich's white-at-35% composites to. The departure
from Rich moves into the module header; tests assert the frame shows on a
light canvas and matches Rich's on black, not the attribute string.

* docs(export): rewrap export-svg header (rich-export-9a1.f98)
